subject: GreenLine Supplies — onboarding docs, W-9 & PO activation
thread_text:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@greenline.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:03:22 -0700
Subject: GreenLine Supplies — onboarding docs, W-9 & PO activation

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the data-center rack hardware purchase. We're ready to get GreenLine set up in our procurement system so we can issue a PO and start the onboarding cadence. To move this along we need a couple of items from your side: 

- Completed vendor setup checklist (attached) — basic company info for our AP record.
- A completed W-9 (or W-8BEN-E for non-US entities). Please attach as PDF.
- Bank details: we prefer ACH; if you'd rather use wire please note that in the bank form.
- Primary billing contact phone and best time to reach.

Once we have the W-9 and ACH form we can create a vendor code and issue a PO (typical turnaround 2–3 business days). Monica from Finance is copied to handle banking and tax acceptance. Rishi — please flag anything else we should require for third-party onboarding.

Attachments: vendor_setup_checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

Hi Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the checklist — attached is our W-9 (W-9_GreenLine_2026.pdf). We can do ACH; our CFO has asked whether Redwood requires a company ACH authorization form or if a bank letter suffices.

Also, our AP team needs to know the vendor code and the PO number format so invoices can be routed correctly.

Phone for billing/contact: (212) 555-0198, Mon–Fri 9am–5pm ET.

I attached the signed W-9 and am happy to complete any ACH doc you send over.

Best,
Elena Marquez
VP Finance, GreenLine Supplies
elena@greenline.co | +1 212-555-0198

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@greenline.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 14:12:05 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenLine Supplies — onboarding docs, W-9 & PO activation

Hi Elena —

W-9 received, thank you — it's in good order. For ACH we do ask vendors to complete our ACH authorization (standard banking details + voided check or bank letter). I have prepared the form and will send a DocuSign link now: https://redwoodincorp.docusign.com/complete/ABC123 (link expires in 7 days). Please complete and sign that so we can validate routing and set up payments.

A couple quick notes on invoices/POs: 
- Once the vendor code is created we will issue a PO with the format RL-YYYY-#### (e.g., RL-2026-3417).
- Invoices should reference the PO number and be sent to ap-invoices@redwood.ai for automated routing.
- Our standard payment terms are Net 30 unless a different cadence was mutually agreed.

If you can complete the ACH via DocuSign and confirm the account holder name matches the W-9, we'll move the vendor code creation to the top of the queue. Also please attach a copy of a voided check or bank letter if available.

Attachments: ACH_authorization_form.pdf (please sign via DocuSign)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0181

Monica / Vanessa —

I completed the DocuSign for the ACH authorization and uploaded a scanned voided check. The signed form is attached here as ACH_authorization_form_signed.pdf. 

Confirming: account holder name on the bank account is GreenLine Supplies LLC (matches W-9). Last 4 of account: 7812.

We'd prefer Net 30 and will ensure all invoices include the PO number once issued. Any chance you can confirm an expected PO # or timeline so we can match on our end?

Thanks again,
Elena

Hi Elena —

All set on our end. Monica confirmed the signed ACH and W-9 match GreenLine Supplies LLC. We'll create the vendor record and issue the initial PO within 3 business days. Expected PO: RL-2026-3417 (we'll confirm the exact number when it posts). 

Next steps for GreenLine:
- Wait for PO RL-2026-3417 to land in ap-invoices@redwood.ai and your portal.
- Submit invoices referencing the PO number and to ap-invoices@redwood.ai.
- For any billing questions contact Monica (monica_patel@redwood.ai).

Welcome aboard — excited to get started on the rack delivery. I'll attach a short welcome packet with payment instructions and our shipping SLA.

Attachments: welcome-packet.pdf

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147
